title: Set Preferred Networks Request
description: Backs taf_radio_AddPreferredOperator (client appends to its own last-fetched copy of the list before calling this) and taf_radio_RemovePreferredOperator (client fetches via request_preferred_networks, filters locally, then calls this with the result) via INetworkSelectionManager::setPreferredNetworks. Always carries the full replacement list -- there is no discrete add/remove RPC, mirroring the SDK's own setPreferredNetworks(full list) semantics.
